description:
Predict a gene's expression from the sequence around its TSS.

        Expression is cell-type-specific, so `description` (cell type /
        assay context, e.g. 'K562 cell line') is REQUIRED — the API
        rejects requests without it.

        The input rule is the same for every expression model: at least
        9,198 bp, with the TSS at least 4,599 bp from each end. Longer input
        is welcome, up to 500,000 bp. Each model's
        bio_spec.recommended_flank_bp (see list_models) says how many bp to
        supply on each side of the TSS: 4,599 for the default g0-expression,
        which reads 9,198 bp around the TSS, and 40,960 for
        g0-expression-8192, which reads much further. Less flank than a model
        recommends, down to 4,599 bp, is accepted and scored, but that model
        then reads less than it was trained on.

        - A 9,198 bp sequence with the TSS at offset 4,599 (the midpoint)
          needs no `tss_index`.
        - Any longer sequence needs `tss_index`: the 0-based offset of the
          TSS into it. The API cuts what the model reads around that offset
          and never scans for a TSS itself.

        Under 9,198 bp, or a TSS closer than 4,599 bp to either end, is
        rejected here and by the API (422). A locus with no offset is
        rejected too, because it is indistinguishable from a mis-centred
        window. A very N-rich or low-complexity window can also be refused
        by the API (422).

        An offset that is merely WRONG (e.g. counted over a wrapped FASTA's
        characters, or against a chromosome coordinate instead of an offset
        into THIS sequence) still succeeds and scores the wrong window —
        verify meta.task_specific_counts.scored_window in the response.

        Easiest paths: fetch_gene_for_expression(gene) returns a 9,198 bp
        handle with the TSS at its midpoint, valid for every expression
        model, and find_genes_and_predict_expression takes a raw region and
        finds each TSS for you.

description.description: REQUIRED experimental context — cell type / assay / conditions (e.g. 'K562 cell line', 'liver tissue'). Expression is cell-type-specific; the API rejects requests without it.
description.title: Description

model.description: Optional model id; omit for the task default. See list_models.
model.title: Model

sequence.description: DNA bases A/C/G/T/N (case-insensitive). Line breaks are ignored (a wrapped FASTA body may be pasted verbatim; a `>` header line may not). Mutually exclusive with `sequence_ref`.
sequence.title: Sequence

sequence_name.description: Label echoed back in the response (ignored when `sequence_ref` is used).
sequence_name.title: Sequence Name

sequence_ref.description: Handle (seq_…) from any acquisition tool (fetch_ensembl_sequence, fetch_region, fetch_gene_for_expression, load_demo_sequence, load_local_fasta, store_inline_sequence). Mutually exclusive with `sequence`.
sequence_ref.title: Sequence Ref

tss_index.description: 0-based offset of the transcription start site into the sequence, counted in bases (whitespace is ignored). Required unless the sequence is exactly 9,198 bp; must leave at least 4,599 bp on each side (4,599 <= tss_index <= length - 4,599). The model reads the sequence around this offset (9,198 bp for g0-expression, more flank for a model with a larger bio_spec.recommended_flank_bp) and the API reports the slice it used as meta.task_specific_counts.scored_window. Check it: a wrong-but-in-range offset scores the wrong window silently.
tss_index.title: Tss Index
